scheme_name: Prime Minister's Scholarship Scheme for Railway Protection Force
other_conditions: Dependent wards of ex‑serving RPF/RPSF personnel and widows below the rank of Gazetted officer are eligible
Only students admitted through regular admission are eligible
Applicants must have secured at least 60% marks in the Minimum Entry Qualification (MEQ) such as 12th standard, diploma or graduation
A maximum of two wards per family can receive the scholarship
Only institutions/universities/colleges that are registered with AISHE are permissible
Students studying abroad are not eligible
The scholarship can be availed for only one course
benefits_summary: Scholarship of ₹2,500 per month for male students and ₹3,000 per month for female students, payable for the course duration (2‑5 years) along with a personal letter from the Prime Minister.
